summary: Small cross-session task_get read-only recovery guidance correction and pre-dispatch tool-cap negative test. Reuses existing GoalStore, TaskStore, ToolRegistry, TaskBudgetExecution and TaskBudgetStore; no new authority, Planner, runtime budget mechanism, cross-session write path, service restart or old-Run replay.

components.owning_subsystem: Existing task_get tool schema and GoalStore/TaskStore read projection
components.disposition: Clarify that omitted/current goal_id is strictly current-session only; for an already-known cross-session Task require explicit original goal_id+task_id. Keep existing optional parameter and SUCCESS empty-view contract, no enumeration or write grant.
evidence: M2 B/Bprime fresh-session task_get explicit goal_id each recovered in one read; C1 omitted goal_id and exceeded prompt-only 3-call cap.
tests/unit/test_task_get_tool.py cross-session no-goal guidance, no other-goal leak, explicit recovery and byte invariance.
components.verification_level: Independent GLM-5.3 review of final frozen candidate PASS P0/P1=0 and original full R9 CLEAN exit 0 required before push; targeted regressions already passed on prior same-code diff.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Absent current-session goal cannot be treated as task nonexistence or approval to create/modify another Goal. Explicit read does not authorize cross-session write, old Run replay, or budget reset.
components.rollback_route: Revert this text/schema-only change; no task ledger migration, provider state or deployment identity to roll back.

components.disposition: Test omitted goal_id cold-session guidance and privacy boundary, explicit read success, unchanged task bytes, unchanged optional goal_id schema.
evidence: Earlier isolated candidate targeted pytest 171 passed, including new negative case.
No test accesses real network or production Task ledger.
components.verification_level: Final frozen candidate targeted pytest and original full R9 required.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Do not infer read authority from missing current Goal; tests do not grant write permissions.
components.rollback_route: Revert test with corresponding guidance if rejected.

components.owning_subsystem: Existing ToolRegistry and TaskBudgetExecution physical-dispatch unit suite
components.disposition: Prove a controlled grant of three tool invocations permits exactly three side effects, blocks fourth before execute, and charges exactly three reservations. Does not change general unbudgeted Web chat behavior.
evidence: Existing checked_tool_dispatch -> TaskBudgetExecution.reserve -> TaskBudgetStore CAS hard gate, unchanged.
New test checks four ToolResult statuses, side-effect list and durable used/reservation count.
components.verification_level: Final frozen candidate targeted pytest and original full R9 required.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Prompt-only call caps are soft. A hard cap exists only when a valid budget is bound; unbudgeted Web chat cannot claim the same enforcement.
components.rollback_route: Revert the test without modifying the existing runtime budget mechanism.

components.disposition: Declare exact changed paths and G1-G4 of the one existing read-only tool control surface; metadata only.
evidence: scripts/check_architecture_submission.py exact path coverage required by remote CI.
components.verification_level: Check A.5 locally on final frozen commit and on GitHub PR.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Any path mismatch or missing review blocks PR merge; manifest grants no runtime authority.
components.rollback_route: Revert manifest together with this PR.

g1.necessity: A real GLM-5.3 cross-session continuation omitted goal_id and misread the current-session-only empty view, causing extra read calls and an unsupported task-recovery diagnosis.

g2.authority_owner: Existing GoalStore strict-session lookup, TaskStore explicit goal_id read, TaskBudgetExecution/TaskBudgetStore hard gate when bound
g2.non_duplication: No new task ledger, Planner, write permission, tool-budget authority, fallback global goal search or recovery daemon.

model_evidence: M2 B/Bprime explicit task_get one-call success and C1 omission/4-call counterexample.
Frozen patch negative tests and independent GLM-5.3 reviewer PASS P0/P1=0 required.
g3.recovery_or_reason: No active Goal in the current session remains a safe empty view, with explicit guidance to supply original goal_id; it never implies task deletion or permission to create/write Goal.

g4.rollback: Revert only the schema/empty-view wording and accompanying tests/manifest; old Run and deployed services remain untouched.
